title: Tech Wars
statusNote: Plays. The card installer accepts this plain Series 60 application once the pack tool has renamed System/App to System/Apps (the zip in testdata already has that). It shows its controls screen, title and main menu, then a duel in a 3D arena: the bot runs, turns, leaves its light bar, rounds are won and lost, and the pause box and the help pages work. Only Arena #0 in Duel mode was played.
notes: The game starts in Spanish. For English choose Opciones on the main menu, then press right on Idioma.
5 continues and selects everywhere; the pad moves through menus and left and right change a value.
A duel is lost when the bot runs into a light bar or the arena edge, so it has to be steered from the first second. After the last round the game waits for 7 to go back to the menu.
Multiplayer needs a Bluetooth link to a second phone and cannot work here.

controls.source: The game's own controls screen at start-up and its help pages (Options > Help): left and right move the bot, 7 is turbo. The soft keys and the menu keys were observed. The help also lists "R. Hand: Change Sight"; which key that is was not found.

actions.left: Turn the bot left; change a menu value
actions.right: Turn the bot right; change a menu value
actions.7: Turbo (hold to charge it); leave a paused or finished battle
